description: This file contains Python unit tests and test case classes for testing FVP (Fixed Virtual Platform) related functionalities, including running FVPs, configuration file loading, and runner behavior.

classes.name: RunFVPTests
classes.description: Test case class for testing the runfvp script functionality, including help, options, environment, and auto-tests.

classes.name: ConfFileTests
classes.description: Test case class for testing configuration file loading and validation.

classes.name: RunnerTests
classes.description: Test case class for testing the FVPRunner class, including start method and environment variable handling.

methods.name: setUpLocal
methods.description: Checks if the runfvp script exists.

methods.name: run_fvp
methods.description: Runs the runfvp script with specified arguments and environment, verifies success or failure.

methods.name: test_help
methods.description: Tests the help output of runfvp.

methods.name: test_bad_options
methods.description: Tests runfvp with invalid options expecting failure.

methods.name: test_run_auto_tests
methods.description: Runs auto-*.json test cases found in the test directory.

methods.name: test_fvp_options
methods.description: Tests runfvp with specific options and parameters.

methods.name: test_fvp_environment
methods.description: Tests runfvp with a specific environment variable.

methods.name: test_no_exe
methods.description: Tests configuration loading with missing 'exe' key, expecting ValueError.

methods.name: test_minimal
methods.description: Tests configuration loading with minimal valid configuration.

methods.name: test_start
methods.description: Tests starting the FVPRunner with a configuration, verifying subprocess call.

methods.name: test_env_passthrough
methods.description: Tests environment variable passing through FVPRunner start method.
